summary: The agent write, edit, and apply-patch paths on the preflight main SHA still persist LF-only batch content. A narrow fix PR is warranted, but this worker has a read-only filesystem, no installed dependencies, and no Windows CMD host, so it could not implement or validate the fix. The named updater restart helper has been removed; its current scheduled-task replacement already generates CRLF and uses the Windows launcher encoder.

actions.reason: The open issue remains actionable on current main. Runtime reproduction and implementation require a writable checkout.
Closed historical context; no closure action is valid.
Implementation and validation cannot run in this read-only worker. The executor needs a writable checkout and Windows proof host.
